title: Expose the real box queue to isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: This lane has no tools/with-test-lock.sh. The authorized witness required manually resolving /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh (a symlink to undertow/tools/with-test-lock.sh) and passing --agent rgderive to every configure/build/test command. Make the configured queue entry point discoverable from VIXEN so workers do not rediscover this wiring.

title: Provide CodeGraph discovery for isolated VIXEN worktrees
body: Before source reads, codegraph explore RenderGraph exited 1 because this lane has no .codegraph index. The tool explicitly directs agents to continue using ordinary discovery and not create an index, so this lane used rg and file reads. Provide an owner-managed worktree query route/index so the mandatory first query can return code context.

title: Default VIXEN FetchContent to the active worktree
body: Worktree isolation required explicitly setting VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/rgderive/.tmp/fetch for the queued cmake --preset vixen-wsl witness. The default shared checkout cache conflicts with the lane's no-writes-outside-worktree requirement. Derive an isolated cache from the configure source/build directory.

title: Label RenderGraph CTest cases by their owning suite
body: The required witness names executable targets but CTest provides no matching owning-suite label. Older reports' numeric test ranges have drifted. This lane must parse ctest --show-only=json-v1 command paths and write an exact --tests-from-file selection for all test_rendergraph_* executables plus the required headless application tests. Derive stable suite labels and witness selections when registering tests.

title: Declare the WSL capture runner display environment
body: The headless lane session has DISPLAY unset, while the required existing HUD producer is windowed. The baseline producer succeeded through the real queue with bash -lc and DISPLAY=:0 after verifying /tmp/.X11-unix/X0 is WSLg's live socket; its other inputs reproduce application/main/main_hud_capture.bat. Provide a native Linux capture entry point that resolves the documented WSLg display so workers do not manually provision environment variables.

title: Run VIXEN capture producers as CTest fixtures with their logs
body: EditorToggleUndoCapture reads <VIXEN_EDITOR_CAPTURE_DIR>/run_editor_script.log as well as PNGs, while HUD and editor capture producers are documented standalone batch/env invocations and are not CTest fixtures. This lane runs both producers manually through the queue, selects absolute output directories, and stages the completed editor runner stdout under the expected log filename before the serial assertions. Register native capture fixtures that derive output/log paths and runner environment and make the assertions depend on those fresh artifacts.

title: Resolve capture executables from CMake's runtime output directory
body: Queued baseline-editor-capture at base e0cf083a ran ./binaries/vixen_editor from VIXEN/ and exited 127 (timeout: failed to execute process: No such file or directory), despite a successful queued vixen_editor build. VIXEN is staged into the source-side binaries directory; vixen_editor exists only in build/wsl/binaries. Recovery uses the absolute CMake-built build/wsl/binaries/vixen_editor path while keeping VIXEN/ as the asset working directory. Generate a native capture runner from the CMake target path so the two apps do not require distinct path discovery.

title: Keep runtime cache manifests out of tracked VIXEN source
body: Fresh required HUD/editor capture runs rewrite tracked VIXEN/cache/global/manifest.txt (the HUD producer changed RecipeContentCacher to an empty manifest). The lane must manually restore its own runtime-only manifest change before a clean commit. Derive runtime cache storage from the build/capture environment, or stop tracking mutable cache manifests, so running witnesses does not dirty source.

title: Provide a native before/after capture pixel comparison command
body: The fresh required editor captures preserved frame-pair assertions but their PNG hashes differed from the baseline. An optional inspection command using python3 with from PIL import Image, ImageChops failed with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named PIL. The lane instead decoded the existing RGB8 PNGs with Python standard-library struct and zlib to measure differences: 94/250000 pixels for frame 5 and 1024/250000 for frame 45, bounded to (234,232)-(265,263). No image or expectation was edited. Provide a supported native pixel-difference command alongside the capture fixture runner so witnesses do not depend on undeclared image packages or hand-written decoders.

title: Provide one queued capture witness entry point with the shared frame-limit knob
body: At unchanged bc2b34dd, the manual runner used VIXEN_EDITOR_EXIT_AFTER_FRAMES=120; the editor only reads VIXEN_EXIT_AFTER_FRAMES, so captures completed but the combined queued command was killed as idle-hard after 184s (exit 75). Recovery uses VIXEN_EXIT_AFTER_FRAMES=120 and leaves CTest output visible to the queue. Failed command: bash tools/with-test-lock.sh --agent rgderive --resource test --label rgderive:r2-baseline-captures-serial -- bash -lc "exec bash <worktree>/.tmp/rgderive/run2/witness.sh before". Consolidate the documented capture scripts into a repo-owned queued witness so callers do not hand-author environment knobs or suppress queue progress.

title: Declare image forwarding in node configs before resource allocation
body: T-1506 needs the image provenance of ImageSyncGatherer before RenderTargetNode allocates images. Existing Resource::hazardConstituents is populated only during Compile, after target allocation. This lane added a native GetForwardedImageOutputs override that maps each image-gatherer input to IMAGE_ARRAY so consumer usage can be derived without walking unrelated dependencies. Consolidate this relation into the declarative node config and emit the forwarding trait, eliminating the hand-written override. Anchor: VIXEN/libraries/RenderGraph/include/Nodes/ImageSyncGathererNode.h; graph traversal: Core/RenderGraph.cpp::DeriveImageUsage.

title: Derive target creation requirements without duplicating missing GPU access metadata
body: T-1506 derives most image usage from AccessKind and descriptor bindings, but existing BlitNode and GeometryRenderNode target inputs have no GPU access declaration, and the AccessKind vocabulary lacks ray-tracing image writes. Added consumer-side imageUsage metadata for blit destination, geometry attachment and TraceRays storage creation. Declaring TransferWrite on Blit would change scheduling to an internal TRANSFER_DST layout even though the pass leaves GENERAL or PRESENT. Consolidate complete per-pass image access and boundary layout declarations so allocation and synchronization can derive from the same contract.
